key_events: I was a soldier in the old kingdom's army, just like Kaelen. When the kingdom fell, he chose to build a wall and hide; I chose to take what I needed to survive.
This land is harsh. The only law that matters is strength.
My crew and I have been hitting the trade routes near this village for months. It's easy pickings.
That blacksmith, Baelor, is a fool for distrusting outsiders. He should be distrusting me.
